events.factual_description: The Mansion at Strathmore presents inti figgis-vizueta's Music for Transitions in North Bethesda on Thursday, December 10, 2026 at 7:30 PM, featuring cellist Andrew Yee and the Rothko String Quartet. figgis-vizueta's official schedule independently confirms the December 10 Strathmore performance and places it between the project's December 8 Minneapolis stop and December 11 National Sawdust performance in Brooklyn. National Sawdust's primary project page documents Music for Transitions as figgis-vizueta's 2026 debut record, performed by Yee and the Germany-based Rothko String Quartet, and describes the program as the culmination of more than six years of collaboration centered on group improvisation and constant musical transformation. A separate stable Strathmore purchase destination and stable face-value price were not verified from primary static sources in this pass, so neither is inferred.

enrichment.note: The date, 7:30 PM start, Mansion venue and Yee/Rothko String Quartet billing are corroborated by the Strathmore engagement listing and figgis-vizueta's official schedule. National Sawdust and CAP UCLA primary pages for the same 2026 touring project verify the debut-record, group-improvisation and multi-city context. A separate stable event-specific purchase destination, stable face-value price and exact Apple Music destination were not verified and remain blank rather than being inferred.

en.why_it_matters: The draw is the language built across six years between figgis-vizueta, Andrew Yee and the Rothko String Quartet: an extra cello expands the quartet into a string-quintet field where composed material, group improvisation and constant transformation can keep changing the weight of the ensemble. Bringing the Music for Transitions project to the Mansion gives the DMV a direct look at the collaboration behind the debut record rather than a generic new-music program.
en.trip_verdict: If the local calendar is open, this is worth choosing in North Bethesda. The same project reaches Brooklyn the next night, so for a DMV listener the Mansion is the practical opportunity to hear it without inventing a corridor trip around the music.

es.why_it_matters: El atractivo está en el lenguaje construido durante seis años entre figgis-vizueta, Andrew Yee y el Rothko String Quartet: un chelo adicional expande al cuarteto hacia un campo de quinteto de cuerdas donde el material compuesto, la improvisación colectiva y la transformación constante pueden cambiar continuamente el peso del ensamble. Llevar Music for Transitions a The Mansion le da al DMV una mirada directa a la colaboración detrás del disco debut, no un programa genérico de música nueva.
es.trip_verdict: Si el calendario local está abierto, ésta es una buena noche para escoger en North Bethesda. El mismo proyecto llega a Brooklyn al día siguiente, así que para alguien en el DMV The Mansion es la oportunidad práctica de escucharlo sin inventar un viaje por el corredor alrededor de la música.
